title: Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array
statementHtml: Given an integer array nums, return the maximum result of nums[i] XOR nums[j], where 0 <= i <= j < n.
examples:
Input : nums = [3, 9, 10, 5, 1]

Output : 15

Explanation :

The maximum XOR value is 10 XOR 5 => 15.

Input : nums = [26, 49, 30, 15, 69]

Output : 116

Explanation :

The maximum XOR value is 69 XOR 49 => 116.
